changelog:
crm-memory 1.0.0

- Migrated crm-memory skill to use BlueColumn persistent cloud memory (vector store).
- Replaced previous markdown file/dir memory system with a BlueColumn API-based workflow.
- Requires BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*); setup instructions updated.
- Includes quick API usage examples for storing, recalling, and searching CRM memory.
- All previous meta/config/markdown files were removed; now streamlined to BlueColumn platform integration.
summary: Give AI agents CRM memory for sales teams. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent manages deals, contacts, and pipeline; when the user wants to store, recall, or search crm memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
